title: Making onboarding feel effortless
summary: Maya requested an onboarding checklist before the next working session. No delivery date was agreed.
transcript:
Maya Chen: The first week still feels a little scattered. Could we put together one onboarding checklist for the team?

Alex Morgan: Yes. I’ll outline what it should cover so we can review it in our next working session.

Maya Chen: Great. It should include who owns each step, too.

Alex Morgan: Let’s confirm the owner and timing when we review the draft.
